title: Build and run a container image
description: Use when building a Docker image from a Dockerfile, running it, and listing local images.
overview: Builds an image while the build log streams, runs the container, lists images, ends on a recap slide.

source.title: Build and run a container image

steps.actions: Run `docker build -t app .` in the directory with the Dockerfile.
steps.success_criteria: The build log ends with FINISHED and names the image.

evidence.quote: docker build -t app . to build the image
docker run app starts a container

steps.success_criteria: The app image appears with the latest tag.

evidence.quote: docker images lists what was built
